Phase 01

Arrival & Initial Contact

6:30 PM – 12:41 AM • Exhibits A – D

Oct 18 2019 6:30 PM
Phase 1
Factual Record
Lauren Deal and Friends Arrive at Goodfellas.
Background

Deal and companions began their evening drinking at Goodfellas before moving to Schooly's bar in downtown Sanford.

Oct 18 2019 9:30 PM
Phase 1
Factual Record
Deal Group Arrives at Schooly's.
Timeline Baseline

Deal group arrived at Schooly's approximately 2.5 hours prior to Benjamin Allen's arrival, establishing continuous presence and consumption at the bar.

Oct 19 2019 12:08 AM
Phase 1 Exhibit A
Surveillance Record
Benjamin Allen and Friends Arrive at Schooly's. Surveillance captures Allen entering with companions; Deal is not at the entryway and no interaction occurs.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal claimed that upon Allen's arrival, she greeted him immediately with a hug and they spent the evening together.

Fact: Video proves Allen arrived with his own party; Deal was elsewhere in the bar with no contact.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 12:35 AM
Phase 1 Exhibit B
Surveillance Record
Peter West Leaves Bar Alone. Surveillance confirms West's solo departure without interacting with Allen or Deal.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Narrative asserted Peter West remained with Deal or interacted with the party during the relevant timeline.

Fact: Peter West departed Schooly's unaccompanied at 12:35 AM, long before any subsequent events.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 12:41 AM
Phase 1 Exhibit C
Surveillance Record
Love & Morrison leave Schooly's never having spoken to defendant or friends. Surveillance cameras capture Carmen Love and James Morrison departing completely independently.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Warrant affidavit and trial narrative alleged Love and Morrison interacted with Allen or witnessed interactions around 2:00 AM.

Fact: Video proves Love and Morrison left the bar at 12:41 AM without speaking to Allen, over an hour before the alleged time.

Oct 19 2019 12:41 AM
Phase 1 Exhibit D
Surveillance Record
Deal makes contact with Ben Allen as Carmen and James walk out the door. Video shows Deal initiating contact by approaching Allen.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal claimed Allen sought her out and initiated conversation upon spotting her across the bar.

Fact: Video captures Deal actively walking across the room to intercept Allen as other patrons leave.

View Graphic Insert
Phase 02

Escalation & Unwanted Contact

12:45 AM – 1:12 AM • Exhibits E – I

Oct 19 2019 12:45 AM
Phase 2 Exhibit E
Surveillance Record
Deal tries to introduce Allen to a group of people and Allen walks off. Lauren tracks him down and follows him.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal claimed mutual socializing and continuous companionable engagement throughout the night.

Fact: Video captures Allen repeatedly walking away from Deal, who repeatedly pursued him across the room.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 12:46 AM
Phase 2 Exhibit F
Surveillance Record
Deal and Allen argue when Deal says that he has to drive her. She gives her keys to DeMarco when Allen refuses them.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal testified Allen agreed to be her ride and assumed responsibility for driving her vehicle.

Fact: Video confirms Allen explicitly refused her keys; Deal handed them to DeMarco instead.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 12:47 AM
Phase 2 Exhibit G
Surveillance Record
Deal and Allen continue to argue over Deal making herself part of his night demanding that his DD can now drive her also.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal claimed an amicable consensus existed to continue the evening at Allen's residence.

Fact: Video captures a heated argument after Allen told Deal she could not simply invite herself to his home.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 12:54 AM
Phase 2 Exhibit H
Surveillance Record
Deal hugs Allen but it isn't returned. Allen keeps his hands in his pocket while Deal leans into him.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal described mutual physical affection and continuous flirtatious rapport.

Fact: Video shows Deal initiating physical contact while Allen stands completely rigid with both hands buried in his pockets.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 01:12 AM
Phase 2 Exhibit I
Surveillance Record
Deal hanging all over DeMarco and Happel before they leave the bar area. The group attempts to create distance.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal testified she was singularly attentive to Allen and behaving in an unproblematic, socially normal manner.

Fact: Video captures Deal hanging over DeMarco and Happel, prompting the companions to exit the bar area while Deal followed them.

View Graphic Insert
Phase 03

Repeated Disruption & Incapacitation

1:26 AM – 1:58 AM • Exhibits L – P

Oct 19 2019 01:26 AM
Phase 3
Factual Record
Deal ends up at the table so Allen returns to the bar area. Allen makes a comment about Deal to guy at bar.
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal described uninterrupted proximity and continuous mutual engagement.

Fact: Record shows Allen repeatedly relocating across the bar to avoid Deal's presence.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 01:29 AM
Phase 3 Exhibit L
Surveillance Record
Deal approaches Allen and almost trips while barefoot. Video shows noticeable physical instability and loss of balance.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal testified she was sober, poised, and walking normally inside the bar.

Fact: Video captures Deal staggering barefoot, stumbling, and struggling to stay upright as she pursues Allen.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 01:47 AM
Phase 3 Exhibit M
Surveillance Record
Deal approaches Allen again and almost knocks over a stool at the bar due to her intoxication level.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal denied severe intoxication or losing motor control inside Schooly's.

Fact: Video captures Deal bouncing off bar furniture and nearly upending a heavy barstool.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 01:51 AM
Phase 3 Exhibit O
Surveillance Record
Deal approaches Allen a third time. This time Deal makes a scene and everyone is staring at her as she throws drunken fit. People shake Allen's hand for how well he dealt with her. She leaves the bar at 01:52.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal described an orderly, consensual departure alongside Allen.

Fact: Video captures Deal throwing a public scene with bar patrons staring, followed by patrons shaking Allen's hand for his restraint as Deal exited at 1:52 AM.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 01:58 AM
Phase 3 Exhibit P
Surveillance Record
Allen goes out to check on Deal and finds her on the concrete outside. Video shows Deal lying incapacitated on the pavement.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: Deal testified she walked out normally and was fully alert and ambulatory.

Fact: Video captures Allen checking on Deal outside to find her lying on the concrete ground incapacitated.

View Graphic Insert
Phase 04

Bar Exit & The Impossible Window

2:04 AM – 3:45 AM • Exhibit Q

Oct 19 2019 02:04 AM
Phase 4 Exhibit Q
Surveillance Record
Happel and DeMarco exit at different times. DeMarco has to go back in to retrieve Lauren's shoes since her face is in the concrete, barefoot, and refusing to get up. Allen asked everyone that left the bar if they had room for one more. Once they looked over and saw Lauren, they all said no.
WATCH VIDEO
Contradicted Claim

Claim: State claimed Allen isolated Deal and arranged an immediate private exit to assault her.

Fact: Video and witness testimony show Allen repeatedly asking departing patrons for assistance in transporting Deal before the group assisted her.

View Graphic Insert
Oct 19 2019 02:20 AM
Phase 4
Factual Record
Group leaves for Allen residence. Transit time to the residence is approximately 14–16 minutes.
Transit Geography

Driving distance from Schooly's to the Allen residence confirms arrival at approximately 2:34–2:36 AM, leaving zero operational window for the State's alleged sequence.

Oct 19 2019 02:35–02:40 AM
Phase 4 Critical Window
Physical Impossibility
Physically Impossible Assault is Claimed. The State alleged an elaborate assault occurred between 2:35 and 2:40 AM—an elapsed window of fewer than 5 minutes that requires impossible transit, navigation, assault, dressing, and egress.
Physical Impossibility

Claim: State alleged a prolonged, violent assault in a pitch-black unfamiliar room within minutes of transit.

Fact: Physical layout, lighting impossibility, missing hour, and subsequent hospital departure render the State's narrative physically impossible.

Oct 19 2019 03:45 AM
Phase 4
Medical Record
Deal arrives at Central Carolina Hospital for medical evaluation.
Forensic Evaluation

Hospital intake records and forensic examination document the post-incident medical timeline and physical findings.
